def.label: Mk1 jamming pod
def.note: Doc 16 section 9 item 4's pod, and the whole of it is the jamming block: this row is a jammer and not a sight, so nothing mounts it with role sensor and the arena never reads the six detection fields above. They are the schema's floor -- max_range_cells 1 because the decoder's range is 1 to 1024, the rest neutral -- and this note is the reason they are not numbers anybody tuned. radius_cells 6 is a 60 m bubble at cell_cm 1,000: a pod defends the ground around itself and has to be driven where it is wanted. attenuation_cost 25 is priced off the atlas's opacity table, where one belt of light woods attenuates 25: an eye inside the bubble keeps 15 of the Mk1 sight's 40 and stops seeing through the belt it saw through before. signature_permille 150 is doc 16 section 2 W1 -- standard ECM defeats detection at long range -- as arithmetic: the Mk1 sight's 600 m against a tank stopped on open ground falls from 540 m to 81 m, which is why a fight inside a bubble is fought at pistol range.
